sections.heading: What is trending: “iphone duo”
paragraphs: “iphone duo” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for JP (snapshot taken 2026-10-02T15:48:38+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 5,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 2 Oct 2026 05:10:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-02T15:48:38+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-02T15:49:45+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from WIRED.jp, Yahoo!ニュース, ダイヤモンド・オンライン. The associated headlines are: “折り畳み式iPhone 最大の激戦地は中国” (ダイヤモンド・オンライン); “アップルの「iPhone Duo」は、従来の折り畳みスマートフォンと何が違う？ 使って見えた進化のポイント” (WIRED.jp); “iPhone Duo発売でiPad miniの立ち位置がビミョーに。次の一手はあるのか？（ギズモード・ジャパン）” (Yahoo!ニュース).

faq.q: How many people searched for “iphone duo”?
faq.a: Google reports at least 5,000 searches in JP as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers JP. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
